sources.note: USA.gov lists NASA's 2027 Gateways to Blue Skies competition as active. The official competition host independently confirms the competition opened August 18, 2026, Phase-1 Notice of Intent is due October 12, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET, the proposal/video deadline is February 22, 2027 at 11:59 PM ET, up to eight finalist teams receive $9,000 each, and eligibility is limited to student-led teams of 2-6 from accredited U.S.-based postsecondary institutions with one faculty advisor and at least two U.S.-citizen/permanent-resident student members. This is a real current opportunity but specialized, so no generic active case was created.

publish_candidate.title: NASA Gateways to Blue Skies 2027 is open with eight $9,000 Phase-1 finalist awards
publish_candidate.summary: NASA's 2027 Gateways to Blue Skies competition is accepting Phase-1 participation. Student-led teams of 2-6 from accredited U.S.-based postsecondary institutions submit a Notice of Intent by October 12, 2026 and a proposal/video by February 22, 2027. Up to eight eligible finalist teams receive $9,000 each and advance; the rules require a faculty advisor and at least two U.S.-citizen or permanent-resident student members.
publish_candidate.agent_notes: Verified against both USA.gov's federal-challenge discovery entry and the official Gateways to Blue Skies competition pages. Specialized student eligibility means this should remain a discovery opportunity unless a prospective team independently satisfies the full competition agreement; no active case is created by this observation.
